consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the highlight of the show was an exceptional version of 'Morning Dew,' which many consider one of the best of the 1990s. Despite some technical difficulties and mixed feelings about the overall performance, the energy and musicianship during key moments, particularly in the second set, received praise.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 46 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While the 'Morning Dew' was highly praised, technical issues and inconsistent performances led to a more tempered overall reception.
